<!-- pr-reviewer: 3a85cc6f9e3f6ef9152a28afafe05d2460508926 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The safety design holds up. I could not get a plunge into undrilled material by any route I tried. The one blocker is test coverage: two of the hole guards in the generator have no pin of their own.

### What looks good
- **The proof that a hole is drilled is sound and conservative.** A hole is handed to the generator only when all of these hold:
  - the drill's stated diameter is at least the tool's plus 0.1 mm a side;
  - the prior column grid (the stock the program ahead leaves) shows no material over the tool disc plus clearance above the counted depth;
  - the counted depth is the deeper of the grid reading and the drill cone at that radius.

  An unreadable grid, a posed pocket, or no drill all prove nothing, and each is named (`crates/app/src/operation/predrilled_entry.rs:64-110`). The grid is the real backstop. The XY taken from the drill moves is only a candidate, so a drill whose moves are misread still cannot make air where the grid shows material.
- **The generator never invents a hole.** It plunges only where the hole's `floor <= z` and the centre is a legal cutter centre with a proved link (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/predrilled.rs:62-80`). Every level a hole does not serve keeps the asked entry and says why, with the Z numbers.
- **The lifecycle cases are safe.** I checked each with local scratch tests, which I did not push:
  - **Drill deleted:** the pocket goes Stale and regenerates with the helix. The PR's own test pins this.
  - **Drill reordered after the pocket:** the pocket goes Stale, and posting is refused with `P1: inputs moved since generation - regenerate before posting`. After regeneration there is no plunge and the path says "no drilling operation ahead".
  - **Drill in another setup:** `ahead_of` keeps only the same setup, so there is no plunge. The same note appears.
  - **Drill suppressed:** the pocket still plunges, because the grid holds what was planned, by the #110 design. The post is refused by name: `post blocked - operation P1 was generated against the cut of suppressed D1; unsuppress D1 or suppress P1 too`. This works because an unposed Pocket `reads_prior`.
  - **Drill shallower than the pocket:** only the levels it reaches plunge. A drill tip at Z 19 under a Z 20 top serves no level, and each level says "open only to Z 20.262".
- **The other pieces check out:**
  - the refusal on any kind other than Pocket is by name (`PREDRILLED_POCKET_ONLY`);
  - the flag is an undoable `EditOperationParams` field and reachable from MCP;
  - the DTO is written only when on, so earlier files are unchanged;
  - there are no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests, and both new modules carry provenance lines.

### Local results (head 3a85cc6f, already contains upstream/main df90b031: trial merge "Already up to date")
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --no-run` | built |
| motion: lib + 37 gate-mapped suites (all but the slow finish3d / multiaxis*) | all passed - lib 290, machining2d 66, machining3d 23, predrilled_entry 6, rest2d 10, level_links 12, entry_approach 9, xy_arc_entry 5, ... 0 failed |
| app: lib + 24 suites (predrilled_entry 8, drill_prior 12, drill_prior_kinds 4, verify 21, operations 119, project_roundtrip 73, mcp 22, posting 17, golden_cl 32, commands_undo 30, roughing2d 7, mill2d_b/c 9+9, stock_stamp 4, remachining 6, rest_across_setups 7, solid_law_goldens 7, ...) | all passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` | clean |
| ui suites | not run: no UI change. The author's quick gate ran them green. |

**Mutation check.** Each guard was deleted one at a time, then the PR's app, lib and motion predrilled tests were run:

| Guard | Result |
|---|---|
| width check `h.radius >= need` (`predrilled_entry.rs:83`) | caught |
| grid floor dropped (cone only) | caught |
| cone floor dropped (grid only) | caught |
| posed guard | caught |
| level depth `h.floor <= z + Z_EPS` | caught |
| centre-cutting guard | caught |
| flag gate in `active()` | caught |
| unserved note | caught |
| `reseat` disabled | caught |
| `job.rs` drill collection for the pocket | caught |
| `named_refusal` PREDRILLED_POCKET_ONLY | caught |
| DTO write | caught |
| area check `l.cen.chord_ok(h.at, h.at)` alone (`predrilled.rs:73`) | **survives** |
| link proof `(h.at == e \|\| links_to(l, h.at, e))` alone (`predrilled.rs:73`) | **survives** |
| both of the above together | caught (`a_hole_outside_the_cutter_area_is_never_plunged`) |
| `usable()` finite check | survives (NaN already fails `chord_ok` and `floor <= z`: equivalent) |
| `is_sane` predrilled line (`sane.rs:72`) | survives (`named_refusal` runs first on create, edit and load; retype seeds fresh params, so only paste reaches it: defence in depth) |
| stamp byte `0xC7` (`params.rs:1708`) | survives, but toggling the flag still stales the pocket without it (scratch test passes on both). The flag is digested elsewhere, so this is equivalent. |
| `drilled()`: count upward or non-vertical feeds | survives (drill feeds are vertical, the deepest tip is kept, and the grid backs it: equivalent) |

### Requested before merge
1. **Pin the area check and the link proof each on its own** (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/predrilled.rs:73`). Under the standing rule, every new refusal needs a test that fails when its own line is deleted. Today `a_hole_outside_the_cutter_area_is_never_plunged` is caught only when both are deleted, because each one masks the other. I tried to reach the link proof alone from the public `pocket_entered` and could not: two disjoint pockets, and a pocket with a central island under Zigzag, Waterline, Adaptive and OffsetRings, all give identical paths with the link proof removed. `reseat` and the per-component `cen` make it redundant in every case I built. Either of these is fine:
   - add a unit test inside `predrilled.rs` (`#[cfg(test)]`) that calls `entry()` on a hand-built `Lvl` with a hole inside the cutter area whose link to `e` crosses a pass, and another with a hole outside `cen` that the link proof alone would accept; or
   - if the link proof really is unreachable after `reseat`, say so in the module doc and in the PR's pin table, which now reads "area/link proof dropped - caught". Keep the guard as defence in depth.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The label `conflicts` is stale. The head already contains upstream/main and GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.
- With the flag on and a hole inside the area that serves no level (too shallow), `reseat` still re-seats the plan on it. The re-entry plunge lands in the column the helix just bored, so this is safe. The path does differ from flag-off for no gain. Consider re-seating only on a hole whose floor reaches at least the top level.
- A through hole (column cut empty) is assumed to read as unprovable if the grid's top is non-finite, which is conservative. Worth a line in the decision record if that is intended.
- `generate.rs` (3418 lines), `params.rs` (1751), `job.rs` (440) and `pocket.rs` (439) each grow slightly past the ~400-line guide. Noted only.
- `Refs #1449` (slice 1), the `Changelog:` line and the decision file are all present, with no `CHANGELOG.md` edit and no process-file change.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3a85cc6f9e3f6ef9152a28afafe05d2460508926 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good
- The generator never decides a hole exists: `proved_holes` (app) hands over only holes proved open in the prior stock grid, and `motion::predrilled::entry` then re-proves the centre and the dive link per level. Unproved cases keep the asked entry and say why on the path.
- Flag off means no path change: `reseat` is gated on the flag, `entry`/`unserved` return early when inactive, and `pocket()` calls `pocket_entered(.., &[])`. No golden or snapshot touched.
- The flag is an ordinary params field, so it is undoable through `EditOperationParams` and reachable from MCP `edit_operation`/`add_operation` (pinned by `mcp_sets_and_undoes_the_flag`). It is refused by name on other kinds. Decision file present, no new crate dependency, no process files, files under ~400 lines, provenance lines present.

## Safety floor, one by one
1. Narrow or shallow hole: narrow is refused by name by the drill's stated diameter against tool + 0.2 mm (`a_drill_no_wider_than_the_tool_plus_clearance_is_refused_by_name`, plus a unit twin). Shallow: the depth is the deeper of the grid reading and the drill-point cone at the disc radius (full-diameter depth, not the tip), pinned by `a_shallow_hole_serves_only_the_levels_it_reaches` (floor level helixes, named with Z numbers).
2. Typed position: not in this slice (holes come only from Drill ops ahead), so there is nothing to refuse. The PR lists it as remaining on #1449.
3. Entry inside the region and the first sideways move: the hole must be a legal cutter centre (`chord_ok`), and the dive link to the pass start is proved with `links_to`. `reseat` starts the pass at the point nearest the hole, so the link crosses no pass. Pinned by `a_hole_outside_the_cutter_area_is_never_plunged` and by verify silent in `a_drilled_hole_ahead_is_plunged_to_full_depth_and_posted`.
4. Checks not loosened: no verify, gouge, rapid-in-stock or post code is touched. The plunge is justified only by the prior grid. `a_hole_the_grid_does_not_show_is_never_air` and `an_unreadable_prior_proves_nothing` pin this at the unit level, and `deleting_the_drill_takes_the_plunge_away` shows the pocket going Stale and then losing the plunge. There is no end-to-end test of the post refusing a hand-forged plunge into a hole the sim does not show; the existing plunge law is unchanged and the new code only emits plunges it proved. See note a.
5. Byte-identical with no entry set: by the code reading above, and the quick gate (motion and app suites incl. goldens) is green. `with_the_flag_off_the_drill_is_never_read` pins that the drill is not read.
6. `rest2d.rs` (merged today in PR 1491): one line only, `pocket_over(..., true)` becomes `pocket_over(..., true, &[])`. Rest machining passes no holes, so its behaviour is unchanged.

## Results merged with main
On the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43498966130 (main 3ab3f015). Conclusion success: motion suites ok, app suites ok, ui suites ok, 3 steps, 0 failed (wall 14.5 min); `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean. No Windows-only `cfg` in the diff, so no local re-run was owed.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
a. Consider a follow-up test where a path carrying a plunge into a hole absent from the stock sim is posted and refused, to pin item 4 end to end.
b. No golden CL file; the pins assert moves and posted lines directly. Fine for a first slice.
c. The UI group is not built yet, so no structural UI test; the stale `conflicts` label is dropped as the PR merges cleanly.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
